sops.title: Standard operating procedures
sops.empty: No SOPs yet. Write the first procedure or start from the XOS Standard Library.
sops.codeHelp: SOP- and three to five digits, for example SOP-007.
sops.bodyHelp: Separate steps with a blank line.
sops.changedBody: This SOP changed after it was published. Publish it to raise the version and ask everyone to acknowledge again.
sops.acknowledgeBody: You confirm you have read and will follow version {version}.
sops.publishBody: Publishing raises the version and asks everyone to acknowledge it again.
sops.deleteBody: It leaves the library; acknowledgments stay in the audit log.
sops.noAcknowledgments: No one has acknowledged this SOP yet.

documents.title: Documents
documents.empty: No documents yet. Add one with the link to the file and its fingerprint.
documents.locationHelp: The link where the file is stored, for example in the shared drive.
documents.fileHelp: Choose the same file; its SHA-256 fingerprint is computed in your browser and only the fingerprint is sent.
documents.deleteBody: The document leaves the list; its versions stay in the audit log.

verbiage.title: Verbiage library
verbiage.empty: No terms yet. Add the words your org uses so everyone writes them the same way.
verbiage.casingHelp: For example Title Case in labels, sentence case in prose.
verbiage.definitionHelp: One sentence ending in a period. Use commas or colons, never an em dash.
verbiage.deleteBody: The term leaves the library. It can be added again later.

refusals.sop_unpublished: Only a published SOP can be acknowledged. Publish it first.
refusals.sop_acknowledge_self: You can acknowledge an SOP only for yourself.
refusals.sop_version_managed: The version rises only when the SOP is published.
refusals.append_only: Versions and acknowledgments never change once recorded.
refusals.cross_org_reference: That item belongs to another organization.
refusals.document_type_in_use: Remove the event types' requirements for this document type first.
